accepted_values_record_check.name: accepted_values_record_check
accepted_values_record_check.value: ("accepted_values"."decision" = 'accepted' and "accepted_values"."record_id" is not null) or ("accepted_values"."decision" = 'cleared' and "accepted_values"."record_id" is null)

record_annotations_note_check.name: record_annotations_note_check
record_annotations_note_check.value: "record_annotations"."kind" not in ('dispute', 'withdraw') or "record_annotations"."note" is not null

trait_records_reference_check.name: trait_records_reference_check
trait_records_reference_check.value: "trait_records"."primary_reference_id" is not null or "trait_records"."secondary_reference_id" is not null

trait_records_origin_check.name: trait_records_origin_check
trait_records_origin_check.value:
("trait_records"."origin" = 'import' and "trait_records"."import_batch_id" is not null and "trait_records"."import_row_no" is not null and "trait_records"."created_by" is null and "trait_records"."supersedes_record_id" is null)
        or ("trait_records"."origin" = 'manual' and "trait_records"."created_by" is not null and "trait_records"."import_batch_id" is null and "trait_records"."import_row_no" is null
            and ("trait_records"."primary_reference_id" is not null or "trait_records"."supersedes_record_id" is not null))

trait_records_harmonised_check.name: trait_records_harmonised_check
trait_records_harmonised_check.value: "trait_records"."harmonisation" <> 'harmonised' or "trait_records"."level_id" is not null or "trait_records"."numeric_value" is not null

trait_records_value_requires_harmonised_.name: trait_records_value_requires_harmonised_check
trait_records_value_requires_harmonised_.value: ("trait_records"."level_id" is null and "trait_records"."numeric_value" is null) or "trait_records"."harmonisation" = 'harmonised'
